summary: Electrovaya Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its fiscal Q2 2026 results. The filing is a routine earnings release, not a special situation. It discloses quarterly revenue of $18M (up 20% YoY), adjusted EBITDA of $2.8M (up 41% YoY), and net profit of $1M ($0.02/share). Operational highlights include UL2580 certification, robotics shipments, and defense sector progress. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is announced. This is purely an operational update.
